title: RentGuard Renters Policy Tier Entry Requirements
content:
# RentGuard Renters Policy — entry requirements by tier

A RentGuard Renters Policy is written on one of six tiers, and each tier carries its own entry requirements. An applicant is placed on a tier only when every requirement in that tier's column is met.

## Underwriting table

| Requirement | HO-4 Starter | HO-4 Essential | HO-4 Enhanced | HO-4 Premier | HO-4 Premier Plus | HO-4 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum age of the named insured | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| Coverage C personal property limit | within the tier's lowest and highest Coverage C limit | same | same | same | same | same |
| Most paid claims in the last 36 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Apartment | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Single-family rental | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Condominium rental | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Student housing | yes | yes | no | no | no | no |

The lowest and highest Coverage C limit of each tier are the figures of the tier's coverage schedule; the Coverage C limit chosen at binding must lie between the two.

## Points of judgement

- **Age.** On every tier the named insured is at least 18.
- **Claims.** On HO-4 Starter, HO-4 Essential, HO-4 Enhanced and HO-4 Premier an applicant with no paid claim or with one paid claim in the last 36 months meets the requirement, and one with two does not. On HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature an applicant meets it only with no paid claim in the last 36 months.
- **Kind of unit.** Student housing is written only on HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential; apartments, single-family rentals and condominium rentals are written on every tier.

## Hypothetical illustration

An applicant aged 24, renting a unit in student housing, with no paid claim in the last 36 months, meets the age and claims requirements of every tier, but the kind of unit restricts the choice to RentGuard HO-4 Starter or RentGuard HO-4 Essential.
